title: diagram
description: Nodes, arrows and nested groups on an explicit grid, appearing by step. Each node sits in a cell (`col`, `row`, optional spans); edges run between nodes or groups; groups draw a box around all their members. `shown` lists the ids visible at a step (hidden parts keep their place) and `highlight` dims everything else. With `compact` the same definition draws small, shapes only, with one optional `caption`. Set the state props per step with `advance` or `set` on the slide.

cols.description: Number of grid columns. Cells share the element's width equally, with the theme's diagram gap between them.

rows.description: Number of grid rows. Cells share the element's height equally, with the theme's diagram gap between them.

nodes.description: The nodes, each in a grid cell (0-based `col` and `row`, optional `colspan` and `rowspan`). `label` and `sub` are inline Markdown and wrap inside the node. `shape` is `box`, `pill`, `circle` (sized to its label, capped by the cell), `card` (fills its cell, with a stripe on its left edge) or `text` (no outline). `kind` colours a node from the theme's categorical palette. Ids are unique across nodes, groups and edges.

id.description: Unique id, used by edges, groups, `shown` and `highlight`.

sub.description: An optional second line, inline Markdown, in the label size.

shape.description: The outline drawn around the label: a `card` is a rounded rectangle that fills its cell, with a stripe on its left edge and its label left-aligned.

kind.description: An optional kind. Each distinct kind takes the next colour of the theme's categorical palette in order of first appearance in `nodes` (whatever `shown` says): the stripe of a card, the outline of a box, pill or circle. A `text` node ignores it. More kinds than the palette has colours is an error.

col.description: 0-based column of the node's first cell.

row.description: 0-based row of the node's first cell.

edges.description: Arrows from one node or group to another, along the line between their centres, or with `route` around the grid in a lane on one side. An edge's id is its `id`, else "<from>-><to>"; `shown` and `highlight` name edges by that id. `label` is plain text placed beside the arrow's midpoint (on the lane, for a routed edge); `dashed` draws a dashed line; `flow` draws it dashed with its dashes marching from source to target while the page animates.

id.description: Optional id; defaults to "<from>-><to>". Needed when two edges join the same pair.

from.description: Id of the source node or group.

to.description: Id of the target node or group (the arrowhead end).

label.description: Optional plain-text label beside the midpoint; on a routed edge, one line centred on its lane (turned a quarter on a left or right lane).

route.description: Draw the edge around the grid instead of straight: it leaves its source from the middle of the side facing that way, runs along a lane outside the grid on that side and enters its target the same way, with rounded corners. For a loop back ("next round") or a side loop. A self-loop (`from` equal to `to`) leaves a quarter of the way along the side facing its lane and comes back three quarters of the way along. Each routed edge, shown or not, reserves its own lane, so the cells shrink.

flow.description: Draw the line dashed and, while the page animates (not under `?capture`, in a presenter preview or with reduced motion), march its dashes from source to target, without end (ambient motion: CSS only, never waited on, the same markup played or jumped). It stands still while dimmed by `highlight` and in a compact diagram. It enters as a dashed edge does (it fades in). The period is the theme's `--sd-flow-period`.

groups.description: Boxes drawn around their members. `contains` lists node and group ids, so groups nest; the box covers all members whether shown or not, so it never resizes. `label` (inline Markdown) is drawn inside the box's top padding, above its members. Sibling groups must not share cells.

id.description: Unique id, used by edges, `shown` and `highlight`.

label.description: Optional label drawn inside the box's top padding, inline Markdown.

contains.description: Ids of the member nodes and groups.

shown.description: Ids visible at this step: nodes, groups and edges (by edge id). All are visible when absent; when set, anything not listed is hidden but keeps its place. Newly shown nodes and groups fade and scale in and edges draw from source to target on a forward step. An unknown id is an error.

highlight.description: Ids emphasised (nodes, groups, edges); everything else turns the theme's dim color. The change tweens the colors. An unknown id is an error. In a compact diagram a lit node also takes its kind's colour (the accent without a kind) as a wider outline, on a tint of it.

compact.description: Draw the same definition small, as a second view: shapes only, no label text, each shape filling its cell, inside the theme's second-view frame, with the compact gap and pad. `text` nodes and the edges that touch them are left out. Ids mean the same as in the full view, so `shown` and `highlight` read the same on both.

caption.description: One line of inline Markdown at the label size, in its own band at the top of a compact diagram (it is drawn only with `compact: true`; it never wraps or shrinks). A change crossfades.
